transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m here because I keep making myself throw up after I eat. Sometimes it happens in the bathroom at work, or as soon as I get home. I don’t like saying that, but it’s gotten to where it feels like the only thing that calms me down.
Do you find yourself eating large amounts of food in a short period of time, more than what most people would eat under similar circumstances?

Yes. When it happens, I can eat a lot really fast—like a whole bag of chips, some pastries from the corner store, leftovers, and sweet drinks all in one sitting. Sometimes I don’t even realize how much is gone until after.
Do you ever feel like you can’t control how much you eat once you start, like you’re unable to stop eating even if you want to?

Yes. Once I start, it’s like I can’t stop myself. I’ll be telling myself, “Stop, that’s enough,” but my hands just keep grabbing more food. It feels like I’m watching myself do it and I can’t make myself quit.
How often do you make yourself vomit after eating? Is this something that happens several times a week or more often?

Yeah… most weeks it happens at least a couple times. It’s been going on for months. I’ll eat way more than I planned to, and then I try to make up for it by throwing up. Sometimes I’ll also not eat for a while or try to exercise it off.
